articles.title: Velcro-Finned Fish Conquer 50-Foot Vertical Waterfall
articles.summary: In a stunning display of nature's ingenuity, shellear fish use microscopic hooks on their fins to scale the 50-foot Luvilombo Falls in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The grueling climb can take up to 10 hours, with many fish tumbling back down and starting over.

articles.title: Patten and Heliovaara Reclaim Wimbledon Doubles Crown in Thrilling Tie-Break Victory
articles.summary: World No. 1 duo Henry Patten and Harri Heliovaara defeated Arevalo and Pavic 7-6(4), 7-6(3) to win their second Wimbledon men's doubles title. Patten used the victory speech to defend doubles tennis against proposed ATP cuts, calling it 'a fantastic example of the joy that doubles can bring.'

articles.title: Barbara Ling, Oscar-Winning Production Designer Who Rebuilt 1969 Hollywood, Dies at 73
articles.summary: Barbara Ling, the Oscar-winning production designer behind 'Once Upon a Time in Hollywood,' has died at 73. She also designed Batman films and the Michael Jackson biopic 'Michael.'
